evidenceMap.claim: A new disconnect-driven host must consent; an offer neither appoints the nominee nor preserves the old host after fencing.
evidenceMap.source: guards.json: relay-authorization, relay-acceptance and verified-sidecar decisions; relay-conformance.json: policy and manual consent
evidenceMap.execution: participants.json: three explicit choices across four holders in one room
evidenceMap.assumes: Honest verifying endpoints and a current signed policy. Connectivity and deadlines are relay judgments; unnecessary offers are possible.

evidenceMap.claim: Each fresh offer uses the first eligible untried rank and consumes a policy entry.
evidenceMap.proof: induction.json: NewOffer and FiniteOfferBudget for arbitrary finite rank bounds
evidenceMap.source: guards.json: host and receiver ordered lists and first-eligible scan
evidenceMap.execution: participants.json: fresh admission under a successor, then two further transfers
evidenceMap.assumes: Membership order and eligibility inputs. A declining or permanently offline member is not obliged to make progress.

evidenceMap.claim: An older completion/ACK cannot release a newer socket in the repeated-resume model.
evidenceMap.proof: induction.json: M3Resume, RepeatedResume; models.json: four-replacement witness
evidenceMap.execution: participants.json: four fresh same-device completions and two-way chat after each; the separate edition-13 held-ACK test checked blocked draft behavior
evidenceMap.assumes: Unique authenticated incarnations and endpoint replay phases. Not global agreement across contradictory peer histories.

evidenceMap.claim: An effect made visible by the checked publication sites follows the corresponding stored transition.
evidenceMap.proof: induction.json: abstract M1/M2/M3/M4 safety under atomic writes
evidenceMap.source: boundaries.json: five Worker dispatches, two positive authentication publications, relay transaction and idle paths, participant mutation/erase, browser transaction completion
evidenceMap.execution: relay-conformance.json, participants.json; workerd eviction and storage failure runs retain earlier source revisions
evidenceMap.assumes: The platform honors its transaction/receipt contract. Not crash-proof disk persistence or proof that every peer observed a commit.

evidenceMap.claim: Increasing the reply deadline trades fewer premature offers for slower recovery under continuing absence.
evidenceMap.observation: 24 original controlled local trials; six recoverable 18-second trials offered on the released detector and none on the longer comparison. Recovery with continuing absence: 15.57–15.58 s versus 45.20–45.24 s.
evidenceMap.assumes: Clock begins at the first fresh challenge; in temporary holds consent was deliberately delayed until restoration. Process suspension is not physical laptop sleep or an estimate of real-world incidence.

limits: Abstract signatures, MLS and atomic storage, not a proof or independent audit of the complete TypeScript, Rust/Wasm, browser or Worker stack.

Host and relay may deny progress. Connectivity, ordering and deadlines are not independently witnessed. No guarantee of availability after a permanent failure, or a hard bound on wall-clock detection.
Distinct modeled states and proof obligations are not counts of app configurations, users, vulnerabilities or failure rates. The model product does not establish global peer/epoch agreement.
The compound browser execution is one private schedule. It does not exercise a physical laptop sleeping, traffic over a WAN, all interleavings or permanent loss of storage.
